    Args:

    Returns:

        "strength_band": "strong",
        "resolved": True

        "strength_band": "strong",
        "resolved": True
    })

        "source": 6,
        "target": 7,
        "sense": "Condition",
        "coupling": "entailment",
        "strength_band": "strong",
        "resolved": True
    })

    # Precedence relation between atoms 10 and 11
    relations.append({
        "source": 10,
        "target": 11,
        "sense": "Precedence",
        "coupling": "none",
        "strength_band": "strong",
        "resolved": True
    })

    # Cause-Effect relation between atoms 14 and 16
    relations.append({
        "source": 14,
        "target": 16,
        "sense": "Cause-Effect",
        "coupling": "entailment",
        "strength_band": "strong",
        "resolved": True
    })

    # Cause-Effect relation between atoms 15 and 16
    relations.append({
        "source": 15,
        "target": 16,
        "sense": "Cause-Effect",
        "coupling": "entailment",
        "strength_band": "strong",
        "resolved": True
    })

    # Disjunction relation between atoms 14 and 15

        "source": 14,
        "target": 15,
        "sense": "Disjunction",
        "coupling": "co_necessity",
        "strength_band": "strong",
        "resolved": True
    })

    return relations
